_read_me: Settings shared by every dashboard. Each dashboard's own display settings live in its folder (thermometer/config.json, sales-scoreboard/config.json). Metric definitions and the sales team roster live ONLY in rapidhsg/rr-metrics-data; never add them here.
_asOfDate_note: Pins the dashboards to this date's quarter/window. null = auto-roll with the calendar.
_freshness_note: Freshness chip on the Thermometer and Sales Scoreboard. AccuLynx sends the job export at fixed UTC times (checked in Joe's email Nov 16-19, 2026: they land about 4 minutes after 10:00, 13:00, 16:00, 19:00 and 22:00 UTC, which is 5 AM, 8 AM, 11 AM, 2 PM and 5 PM Eastern in winter and an hour later in summer). The builder converts these to Eastern for each day, so daylight saving is handled. The boards update about refreshLagMinutes after a send. Change here only if the AccuLynx schedule changes.
